text:
Noah: Hey folks, leaving the office next week and have a few things to give away: 1) IKEA two-seater couch (light gray, minor stain on left cushion) 2) Dell 27\" 4K monitor (stand included) 3) box of random cables and adapters. Pickup SoMa bench B. Pics: https://imgur.com/a/placeholder
Priyanka: Interested in the couch if someone can help me transport it to my car. Will need it by Sunday.
Gabe: I can help with transport if you take it, Priyanka. I have a small SUV.
Marta: I want the 4K monitor. Any stuck pixels or backlight bleed?
Noah: Monitor is clean, no stuck pixels that I noticed. Calibrated it for photo work. Comes with DisplayPort and power cable.
Priyanka: Gabe that would be amazing. I can pick up Saturday morning. Noah, would you hold the couch until Sat 2pm?
Noah: Yep holding for Priyanka until Sat 2pm. Please DM me your cell and I'll leave it labeled on bench B.
Gabe: Saturday 9am works for me, meet at the loading dock and I'll help carry it down.
Marta: DM sent for the monitor. If no one else claims it I'll grab it Friday after standup.
ops-bot: Reminder: please label items with your name + date and don't leave items overnight without facilities approval.
Noah: Noted. @facilities is bench B ok for overnight Sat? Don't want it to get tossed.
facilities: Bench B is available overnight for personal pickups this weekend. Please place a sticky note with name and date. Avoid blocking the walkway.
Gabe: Also heads up the couch's legs unscrew; easier to move if you remove them first. I can bring tools.
Priyanka: Perfect, thanks Gabe. I'll bring a blanket to protect it from the car.
Marta: Thanks Noah, I'll swing by at 10:30am Friday to pick up the monitor. Do you want me to sign anything?
Noah: Nope just take it and leave a note on the community board that you picked it up. Appreciate it.
Priyanka: DM sent with my phone. See you Sat at 9am at the loading dock.
Gabe: I'll bring straps and an extra set of hands in case we need them.
Noah: Thanks everyone. If plans change I'll update here. :thumbsup:
